description: Focused independent acceptance of RC96. Engineering validation is recorded separately.

items.name: R1 — BYOK and new AI agent
items.description: Set your new-agent default to a supported text model, close/reopen Add Agent, generate and save an agent, then send a real chat. The saved model must match your explicit selection; no image-only model should be offered. Try a missing/invalid key: explain the failure and preserve the draft.

items.name: R2 — Existing agent model refresh
items.description: Open agent Details, use Edit agent configuration in its header, change the model and save. Details must show the new model immediately. An unsupported existing model must show a warning and allow you to choose a replacement.

items.name: R3 — Chat readability
items.description: Ask for a wide Markdown table and code block. Check horizontal table scrolling, copying, follow-up and Resend at desktop and narrow widths. The chat must remain usable without page overflow.

items.name: R4 — Group/community members
items.description: In Communications grid, click the member count on a group and community. Confirm the displayed members, add/remove a test member, save and reopen. Check that names and purpose remain understandable.

items.name: R5 — Workflow with real agents
items.description: Create with AI, review owner, targets, schedule/timezone and content, save, run manually and inspect each participant result and execution logs. Real provider failures must be visible; do not accept only a green creation result.

items.name: R6 — Runtime restart and persistence
items.description: In the isolated preview, create a disposable agent/group/workflow, stop with Ctrl-C and restart the same --root. Confirm data, selected runtime, model, enabled plugins and a real chat still work. Do not stop the on-prem VM for this test.
